verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an API service with an official CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Self-hosted and in-VPC deployment and PII redaction are adjacent privacy features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
